validity: Clean committed source and unchanged frozen evaluator; 16/16 hashes.
Exact raw query artifact path/SHA/protocol/runtime and complete ordered coverage.
Absent isolated condition directory; no resume/overwrite.
Exact O2 flag and B@25 raw/min-max parameter gate.
70 old graphs unchanged; exactly ten new raw indexes and no old index mutation.
Zero query misses/live requests and zero Entity API requests.
Both formal validators, graph constraint, prompt budget, output counts, and stats parity pass.
stop_conditions: Any old artifact deletion, overwrite, or rebuild.
More than ten new index files or any new graph file.
Any live query embedding or Entity extraction request.
Any token, request, wall-time, or storage ceiling breach.
